_about: Offline answers for the eval's get_calendar and get_status questions (#49 review). Not a new call to the City: no request was made to write this file. The GetCalendar body is the one README.md shows for get_calendar ('A normal weekday', 2026-11-09), added with the site's real demos in #29. The Status bodies are the shapes the live API returned on 2026-11-08, as src/status.ts and test/status.test.mjs record them: every status returns inEffect true or false; OEM also returns eventName, empty when nothing is in effect. If the City changes these answers, this file does not change with them.

items.details: Alternate side parking and meters are in effect.
Trash, recycling, and compost collections are on schedule.
